logger.wandb_notes:
A4: step0 curriculum RL from the IK-IL flow-policy checkpoint epoch_800.pt.
Unlike A2/A3, train reset always starts from demo frame 0: single_step=False,
demo_start=False, RSI=False, ET=False. Horizon increases from 4 to 200 env
control steps. actor.model.num_action_chunks=4, so the rollout worker requests
ceil(horizon/4) action chunks. collect_current_horizon_only=True avoids old
fixed-envelope rollout waste; resample_valid_transitions=False plus
sample_to_global_batch_multiple=True resizes the collected valid chunk pool to
the nearest global_batch_size multiple, so PPO updates per global step are about
(#resized_chunks / global_batch_size) * update_epoch. Reward tracks objects and
hand qpos throughout. GPUs 0-3.
